knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Eclectic, quirky and unique is the After Noah way. If you're looking for mid-century, vintage or retro furniture with bags of personality and in a shop like shops should be; you're in the right place. We stylishly curate a broad range of vintage, collectable and restored 20th Century and mid-century modern furniture design classics, along with their contemporary counterparts, so if you are looking for a piece that's out of the ordinary, you're sure to find it here. Our incredible restoration workshop sits at the heart of the business to ensure that even the oldest of pieces have the longest of lives. We also stock the widest range of vintage, traditional and classic toys."
